"""RoboPaint execution record. Camera calibration and tip-only robot control."""
import sys, json, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/runs');OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.])
ZP=.0202
MPP=.227185/1024
class Painter:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot();self.n=len(list(OUT.glob('call_*')))
  self.o=self.r.get_obs(cameras=['scene_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
  self.pose=np.array(self.o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14]);self.cmd=self.pose.copy()
 def send(self,a,note='',cams=('practice_cam','side_cam'),fps=10):
  a=np.array(a).reshape(-1,7)
  for start in range(0,len(a),190):
   rows=a[start:start+190];res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',rows,dt=.05,cameras=list(cams),video='frames',video_fps=fps,note=note)
   self.n+=1;d=OUT/f'call_{self.n:03d}';res.save(str(d));np.save(d/'actions.npy',rows)
   self.pose=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14]);self.cmd=rows[-1].copy()
   print('CALL',self.n,note,'tip',self.pose[:3], 'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
   self.o=res
  return res
 def move(self,xyz,s=1.,hold=.4,note='',cams=('scene_cam','side_cam')):
  dest=np.r_[xyz,Q];n=max(1,int(s/.05));a=np.linspace(self.cmd,dest,n+1)[1:];a=np.vstack([a,np.tile(dest,(int(hold/.05),1))]);return self.send(a,note,cams)
 def obs(self,name,cams=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),depth=True):
  o=self.r.get_obs(cameras=list(cams),depth=depth,video='none');o.save(str(OUT/name));return o
 def dip(self):
  self.move([-.10,.145,.07],2,note='approach ink')
  self.move([-.10,.145,.021],1,hold=.8,note='dip')
  self.move([-.10,.145,.07],1,note='raise inked brush')
 def park(self):self.move([-.1,.24,.1],2,hold=.5,note='park')
 def line(self,points,depths,speed=.008,hold=.0,note='practice',cams=('practice_cam',)):
  pts=np.array(points); dep=np.broadcast_to(depths,len(pts));poses=np.c_[pts,ZP-dep,np.tile(Q,(len(pts),1))]
  self.move([*pts[0],.055],1,note='hover '+note,cams=cams)
  self.move(poses[0,:3],.8,hold=hold,note='land '+note,cams=cams)
  a=[];prev=poses[0]
  for row in poses[1:]:
   n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(row[:2]-prev[:2])/speed/.05)))
   a.extend(np.linspace(prev,row,n+1)[1:]);prev=row
  if a:self.send(a,note,cams)
  self.move([*pts[-1],.055],.8,hold=.2,note='lift '+note,cams=cams)
def uv(u,v):return [.0135925-(v+.5)*MPP,.1135925-(u+.5)*MPP]
if __name__=='__main__':
 p=Painter()

 elif sys.argv[1]=='calibrate':
  p.dip()
  for i,d in enumerate([.001,.003,.006,.010,.015,.022]):
   y=-.153-i*.012;p.line([[-.03,y],[-.085,y]],[d,d],speed=.008,note=f'depth {d}')
  p.park();p.obs('calibrated')
